subject: history
title: The four elements, and taking part

scenes.narration: A democracy has certain key elements which make it the most preferred form of government today: participation and collective decision-making, accountability, conflict resolution, and concern for equality and justice.

nodes: The representative acts for them in the government
props.label: Elections, p.24

scenes.narration: In a democracy, there is a free and fair system of election. People elect the person whom they feel understands their problems the best, and this person acts as their representative.
But participation goes beyond elections. Citizens directly take part in, and influence, government decisions through discussions, debates, speaking out through the media, protest marches and rallies.

questions.prompt: Which is one of the key elements of a democracy?
questions.explanation: Conflict resolution is one of the four key elements (p.24).

questions.prompt: Debates and rallies are ways citizens directly participate.
questions.explanation: Through discussions, debates, the media, protest marches and rallies (p.24).
